tool.title: Record a translation adjudication
tool.description: Turn one translation-review issue into the recorded adjudication: read the `issues` event (never the body from a shell variable), refuse an author who is not an owner, member or collaborator, refuse an item whose catalogue hash changed since the page showed it, then write the translation node's sign-off, the fuzzy suggestions and an append-only `translation-qa` attestation, and leave a Markdown summary. Exit 0 recorded, 3 nothing recorded, 2 could not determine.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The layer root holding the catalogues. Default: the current directory.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: The `issues` event file GitHub wrote. Absent: `$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, which is how the workflow passes it.

outputs.name: records
outputs.description: The files written: catalogues, translation nodes and attestations under the layer's translations and attestation directories.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: What was recorded and what was refused, with each reason — the issue comment and the PR body.

$comment.comment: A runner path, so `FilesystemPath` and no `arg`: it is not an injection-safe command-line word. The script also takes `--event <file>` and `--summary <file>` when run by hand.

`manual` until the tools layer the lock pins declares the checkout script `translation:adjudicate`: `check:tools` refuses a `bun run cat <key>` no mounted layer declares. Once the pin moves past it, `invoke.shell` is `bun run cat translation:adjudicate` and `manual` goes. Until then the reusable workflow `translation-adjudication-workflow` is how it runs.
